details: BFC SmartMoney (DigiRemit- Bahrain) ( Year : 2019 - 2020)

Designed and developed scalable REST APIs for core modules: Money Transfer, Add Beneficiary, Dashboard, and Bill Payment using Core Java, Spring Boot, and multithreading for high-performance operations.
Integrated payment gateway (Benefit Payment Gateway) and third-party services (Shufti, IGA) to ensure secure transactions and seamless user onboarding, reflecting full ownership of SDLC tasks.
Actively collaborated with product stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements, propose solutions, and ensure high-quality delivery aligned with best coding practices.
Led the deployment and production support activities, ensuring reliable and secure operation of critical fintech services.
Tech Stack : OOP's Concept implemented in our project (Abstraction and Encapsulation,lnheritance and Polymorphism)
,Core Java 1.7,SOL Server,RestEasy Jar for REST API, JSP and Servlet for Web,HTML,CSS,JOuery.

projects.name: Project
details: Research and Development: Microservices Migration Project (Year : 2023 - 2024)
Conducted in-depth analysis of the existing monolithic codebase, studying legacy code and database structures to identify migration opportunities.
a Bifurcated the legacy codebase into well-defined, modular services, significantly improving scalability, modularity, and maintainability.
a Designed and developed Spring Boot APIs for each microservice, ensuring clean separation of concerns and reusable components.
Set up Eureka Server for dynamic service discovery and registration.
a Integrated inter-service communication using Kafka, enabling reliable, asynchronous messaging between microservices.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to document migration strategies, share progress, and incorporate feedback for a successful implementation.

a Tech Stack :OOP’s Concept implemented in our project (Abstraction and Encapsulation,lnheritance and Polymorphism), Core Java 17,Spring Boot 3.x for API, Docker ,Sql Server and Oracle, Microservices architecture ,Kafka, Kubernetes.Design Pattern : Singleton,BuiIder,Proxy Server ,Factory.
